alternate_all_time_carrier.scope: controlled legal innovation words for original 20-state pilot parameters

continuation_assignment: one-percent uniform mixture of original cycle
fiber_map: world -> actual current audit stationary probability vector
finite_disintegration: Z_n = (Z_n | actual object 0)/2 + (Z_n | actual object 1)/2, exactly
law_pressure: max of the two conditional pressures; finite prefixes do not affect limits
neighborhood_derivation: Original branch weights are in [1/1000,4/5], so each pressure is 7-Lipschitz and the equal-weight gap is 7-Lipschitz.
object_recognition: compare coordinate zero to the midpoint of the two exact audit outputs
path_integrand: product over t of A_s(i_t,i_{t+1})/K_t(i_t,i_{t+1}); same original A_s
path_reference: world atom, then initial law = its actual completion, then original K_t Markov transitions
pressure_crossing_obstruction: For each original observable, P1-P0 is positive at 5/4 and negative at 3/2. Continuity forces a zero gap somewhere between them. Positivity is a finite-grid and neighborhood claim, not an all-parameter claim.
scope: actual current audit-completion fibers under a constructed package-correlated legal-input world law
